title: Working at Studio Galilei

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Making what drives business growth visible and governable, by building Italy's most talented team in marketing, software and AI.

startingPoint.title: The starting point
startingPoint.text: At Studio Galilei, method, direction, systems and investment share one goal: putting you in a position to perform at your best. Pay is tied to results.

workIsSeen.title: Here your work is seen
workIsSeen.text: Every result is measured and credited to whoever produced it. Whoever moves the numbers wins. Your decisions, your merit.

growth.title: Growth and autonomy
growth.text: You work across different markets (Italy, the United States, Switzerland, Turkey, the Netherlands) with a clear method and full autonomy. You know what is expected of you and you choose how to get there, with a team always ready to help.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.text: Studio Galilei invests in acquiring partners and building tools that multiply the value of your work. You are the protagonist, and you are never alone.
